service.name: Book a carpenter
service.short_description: Book a verified Panun Kaergar carpenter by the hour, half-day, or full day for flexible on-site help with tools and skilled hands.
service.description: Book Carpenter by Panun Kaergar lets you hire a verified carpenter for the time you need. Pick a 1-hour slot for quick fixes, 4 hours for medium jobs, or a full day for larger work. Your carpenter arrives with the right tools, reviews the task on site, completes work within the booked duration, and hands over neatly.
